parsed.claim_reason: Take a_1=2: the greedy sequence is 2,4,6,8,... (all even). Then a_3=6 has prime set {2,3}, which hits {{2},{2}} but so does its proper subset {2}, so it is not inclusion-minimal. Integer-minimality of the greedy choice cannot prune redundant primes, since dividing them out may drop the value below a_n.
